يضطبنوا (form VIII)
# يَضْطَبِنُوا (yaḍṭabinū) /jadˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# يُضْطَبَنُوا (yuḍṭabanū) /judˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
